owner_summaries.key_concerns: Entity-level TB balances are not reconciled, and FX rate coverage does not meet policy requirements.

residual_risks.description: Entity-level trial balance discrepancies could lead to inaccurate financial reporting.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Implement automated reconciliation tools and enforce stricter review protocols.

residual_risks.description: FX rate coverage gaps could result in non-compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Enhance FX rate validation processes and increase frequency of policy compliance checks.

residual_risks.description: High flux analysis exception count indicates potential issues in account variance monitoring.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Investigate root causes of flux exceptions and implement tighter thresholds for variance monitoring.
